name: soma-pub-auth-providers
description: The sign-in providers the deployment serves, so the sign-in page draws one button each rather than guessing. A SIBLING of soma-pub-auth's routes, never a child: soma-pub-auth's oauth2_login matches every `/v1/auth/{provider}` itself, so `/v1/auth/providers` would be read as the provider slug `providers` and 404, whatever the static-vs-param table would otherwise do. `/v1/auth-providers` sits beside it and cannot be captured. Public and unauthenticated, like the sign-in it precedes.
